# `terraform stacks deployment-step` reference

Use the `terraform stacks deployment-step` command to manage deployment steps.

## Description

The `terraform stacks deployment-step` command provides subcommands for managing deployment steps of your Stack. You can inspect deployment steps and retrieve their artifacts using these subcommands.

## Usage

```
terraform stacks <global-stacks-flags> deployment-step <subcommand>
```

## Subcommands

- [`show`](/terraform/cli/commands/stacks/deployment-step/show) - Show details of a deployment step.
- [`artifacts`](/terraform/cli/commands/stacks/deployment-step/artifacts) - Retrieve artifact information for a deployment step.

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/cli/commands/stacks/global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
